shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile in low relief
animal with head turned or lowered
multiple animals stacked vertically on a single upright slab
relief carving on a flat pillar face
limbs rendered as raised ridges with articulated joints
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief profile quadrupeds arranged one above another on the broad face of an upright slab, rendered in the same schematic manner with raised outline bodies and stick-like ridged legs; the vertical stacking of separate animals on a single pillar face is a fairly specific shared scheme. A differs in also carrying a horizontal register band, a row of repeated boxed motifs across the top, birds and a possibly anthropomorphic squatting figure, none of which appear in B, which shows only the animals.
